card_text: Kia and Hyundai parts shop in Kaki Bukit.
Browse parts by model and part type, then ask about price and stock.
lede: Autotex is a parts shop for Kia and Hyundai cars at AutoBay@Kaki Bukit. Pick your model and part on its website, or send your car plate or chassis number on WhatsApp and the shop checks the exact part for your car before you pay. Collection is at the shop, so message first to have the parts ready.

services.d: Bumpers, bonnets, grilles, mirrors, wipers, and head, tail and fog lamps.
Front and rear pad sets, and discs sold in pairs.
Absorbers, arms, links, tie rods and bearings, plus engine and gearbox mounts.
Spark plugs, ignition coils, filters, belts and pumps, plus engine and transmission oil.
Radiators, fans, aircon parts, alternators and starter motors.

price_note: Where the shop's site shows a price it is the price for the part listed. For other parts, ask on WhatsApp for price and stock.
hours_note: WhatsApp first so stock can be checked and the parts ready for collection.

faqs: Do I need the part number?
No. Pick your car model and the part, or send your car plate or chassis number on WhatsApp. The shop checks the exact part for your car before you pay.
Hyundai and Kia only, for models sold in Singapore such as the Avante, Tucson, Kona, Ioniq, Cerato, Sportage, Sorento, Niro and Picanto. Ask if your model is not listed.
At 1 Kaki Bukit Avenue 6, #01-42, AutoBay@Kaki Bukit, Singapore 417883. Open Monday to Friday 9:30am to 5:30pm and Saturday 9:30am to 3:30pm.
Is the price on the website final?
A listed price is for the part shown. For everything else, ask for the price on WhatsApp. Stock and exact fit are confirmed before you pay.
